description: This file defines the SerializerSession class, which encapsulates contextual information and state management for serialization operations within the Orleans framework. It includes properties for type codecs, well-known types, referenced types and objects, and methods for resetting state and disposal handling.

classes.name: SerializerSession
classes.description: A class that maintains contextual information and state for a serialization operation, including type codecs, known types, referenced types and objects, and disposal logic.

methods.name: SerializerSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session with a type codec, well-known types, and a codec provider.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Performs a full reset of referenced objects and types collections.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Invokes the OnDisposed callback if set, for cleanup.
